note: Concept generation settings (D-146, D-147, D-148). route: fair (free models through FAIR) or direct_gemini (the project's DIRECT_GEMINI_API_KEY only, no FAIR, no fallback; free only while the key's Google Cloud project has no billing). concepts_per_call: concepts asked for in one model call; a mechanism's concepts come from several calls of this size, each told which concepts already exist. pause_between_calls_seconds: wait between one mechanism's calls, so Groq's free per-minute token limit is not hit.
